description: This PHP source file defines the class MAX_Admin_Inventory_TrackerAppend, which manages tracker append codes, handles form submissions, and renders a template for tracker code management in an ad server application.

classes.name: MAX_Admin_Inventory_TrackerAppend
classes.description: A class for managing ad tracker append codes, including handling form submissions, retrieving codes, and rendering the management interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, sets default DAL, and retrieves advertiser and tracker IDs.

methods.name: _useDefaultDal
methods.description: Sets the data access layer to the default MAX_Dal_Inventory_Trackers instance.

methods.name: cycleRow
methods.description: Returns a CSS class string for alternating row styles.

methods.name: getPausedCodes
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list of paused tracker codes.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes form submissions to add, delete, move, pause, or resume tracker codes, and saves changes.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Retrieves existing tracker codes if not already loaded.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the tracker append management interface using a template.
